prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.413 °C/min (4% above healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.9 °C (within 1% of healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.38 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.86 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.41 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 399 W·min/l (4% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.9 % (5% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.9 bar (within 1% of healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.393 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS4 mean temperature 31.2 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.38 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.82 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.51 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 391 W·min/l (2% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 57.1 % (3% below healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
